message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live data feeds, so I can’t tell you the current air‑quality index (AQI) or pollutant levels for Los Angeles at this exact moment.

If you need up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to get it |
|--------|---------------|
| **EPA AirNow** | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/ and enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **AirVisual / IQAir** | Go to https://www.iqair.com/, search for Los Angeles, and view the real‑time AQI. |
| **Local news websites** | Many stations publish live air‑quality dashboards. |
| **Mobile apps** | Apps such as “Air Quality Index” or “Plume Labs: Air Report” show real‑time data. |

These sites pull data from official monitoring stations and provide the latest PM₂.₅, ozone, NO₂, etc., values along with health advisories.
message.reasoning: User asks about current air quality in LA. We need real-time data. We don't have direct API. We can approximate using known sources like AQI from EPA or other APIs. But we can't call external services. We could use a placeholder or say we cannot fetch real-time data. We might suggest checking online resources. So answer: cannot provide real-time. Suggest checking AirNow or local news.
